title: Afonso de Albuquerque captures Goa
summary: Portuguese forces under Afonso de Albuquerque retook the island city of Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate after losing it earlier that year.
reason: Albuquerque wanted a permanent fortified base to control the sea lanes of western India.
significance: Goa became the capital of Portuguese India and stayed Portuguese until 1961.
